sections.title: Mental model — bounds travel down, order travels across

blocks.md: **Validation = pass DOWN (min,max) windows. Sortedness tricks = walk ACROSS (prev pointer). Two axes, every BST problem lives on one.**

blocks.label: Validate BST (LC98) — both orthodox forms
blocks.py:
def ok(r, lo, hi):                       # range windows down
    if not r: return True
    if not (lo < r.val < hi): return False
    return ok(r.left, lo, r.val) and ok(r.right, r.val, hi)

# prev-pointer across form:
def inorder(r, prev):
    if not r: return True, prev
    okv, prev = inorder(r.left, prev)
    if not okv: return False, prev
    if prev and prev.val >= r.val: return False, prev
    return inorder(r.right, r)

blocks.md: **Classic trap:** checking ONLY direct children passes [5,4,6,null,null,3,7]-style trees where violation hides two levels deep. Range/prev forms are mandatory.
